explanation: The value is high almost everywhere: D2 is 10 early in the episode and slides to about 7 (5-6 near trial 95); GO is about 9-10 after choosing a2 but lower after choosing a1 (about 6-7 early, falling to 2-4 after trial 85), and gets 1-2 points higher when the previous trial was unrewarded. D1 is usually 8-10 after a rewarded trial, about 9 after one unrewarded trial early on, and drops sharply (0-4) after an unrewarded trial later in the episode, especially after a run of losses or around a switch to a1 after trial 40.
